# `date humanize` for [date](/commands/categories/date.md)

<div class='command-title'>Print a &#x27;humanized&#x27; format for the date, relative to now.</div>

## Signature

```> date humanize {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input          | output       |
| -------------- | ------------ |
| datetime       | string       |
| string         | string       |
| list&lt;datetime&gt; | list&lt;string&gt; |
| list&lt;string&gt;   | list&lt;string&gt; |
## Examples

Print a 'humanized' format for the date, relative to now.
```nu
> "2021-10-22 20:00:12 +01:00" | date humanize

```

Humanize a list of datetimes.
```nu
> [2021-10-22T20:00:12+01:00, 2021-10-23T20:00:00+01:00] | date humanize

```

Humanize a list of date strings.
```nu
> ["2021-10-22 20:00:12 +01:00", "2021-10-22 21:00:00 +01:00"] | date humanize

```
